title: System Card: Claude Haiku 4.5
summary: System card for Claude Haiku 4.5, Anthropic's small/fast model, focused almost entirely on safety: safeguards/harmlessness, agentic safety (malicious use, prompt injection), a lighter-weight alignment and welfare assessment, reward hacking, and ASL-3 rule-out RSP evaluations. Capability benchmarks are deferred to the launch post. The model was deployed under the ASL-2 Standard.

title: System Card: Claude Opus 4.5
summary: Comprehensive system card for Claude Opus 4.5 covering a newly reinstated capabilities section (with decontamination discussion), safeguards and harmlessness (now multilingual), honesty, agentic safety and adaptive prompt-injection testing, an extensive alignment assessment using behavioral audits and interpretability, model welfare, and full RSP evaluations for CBRN, autonomy and cyber. The model was released under ASL-3; Anthropic judged it does not cross AI R&D-4 or CBRN-4 thresholds, while noting rule-outs are becoming increasingly difficult.

title: System Card: Claude Opus 4.6
notes: Current revision (PDF created 2026-03-06); several earlier revisions exist on www-cdn.
summary: System card for Claude Opus 4.6 covering capabilities (incl. long context, finance, life sciences), safeguards and harmlessness (7 languages, experimental higher-difficulty evals, expanded user wellbeing section), honesty, agentic safety and adaptive prompt injection, a large alignment assessment (pilot-use analysis, behavioral audits, external testing by UK AISI, Apollo, Andon Labs, interpretability), model welfare, and RSP evaluations. Released under ASL-3; Anthropic judged AI R&D-4 and CBRN-4 not crossed but called the AI R&D rule-out more tenuous than ever and noted cyber evals are saturated; a separate Sabotage Risk Report was committed.

title: Sabotage Risk Report: Claude Opus 4.6
notes: Companion to Opus 4.6 system card (AI R&D-4 sabotage risk); date per system card changelog; reviewed by METR.
summary: Structured safety-case-style report arguing that Claude Opus 4.6 poses very low but not negligible risk of sabotage (autonomous misaligned actions contributing to later catastrophe), written to meet the RSP AI R&D-4 standard. It rests on four claims (prior expectations, alignment assessment, inability to undermine the assessment, limited opaque reasoning/agentic capability), describes internal monitoring and security safeguards, analyzes eight risk pathways, and lists conditions under which the argument would no longer apply to future models.

title: System Card: Claude Sonnet 4.6
notes: Current revision (PDF created 2026-03-06).
summary: System card for Claude Sonnet 4.6 covering capabilities (incl. multilingual GMMLU/MILU, healthcare), safeguards and harmlessness, user wellbeing, bias, a somewhat lighter alignment assessment, model welfare, agentic safety/prompt injection, and preliminary-assessment RSP evaluations. Released under ASL-3 by reference to Claude Opus 4.6; AI R&D-4 mitigations were proactively applied and a short sabotage risk analysis replaced a full risk report. Unlike Opus 4.5/4.6, there is no standalone honesty section and no external government pre-deployment testing.

title: Risk Report: February 2026
notes: Periodic RSP v3 risk report (redacted), not a single-model card; assesses frontier models incl. Opus 4.6. Published with RSP v3.0; this copy is a later updated revision.
summary: First periodic Risk Report under RSP v3, assessing Anthropic's activities as a whole (not a single model) across four priority threat models: high-stakes sabotage, automated R&D, non-novel chemical/biological weapons, and novel chemical/biological weapons, plus cross-cutting acceleration dynamics and a risk-benefit determination. It largely reuses the Opus 4.6 sabotage risk report and system card evidence, adds lightweight alignment audits of a reduced-refusal Opus model and Claude Gov, and describes ASL-3 deployment safeguards (constitutional classifier guards, bug bounty, exemptions, threat intelligence) in detail. Cyber is not a priority threat model.

title: System Card: Claude Mythos Preview

title: Alignment Risk Update: Claude Mythos Preview
